evidence: No instance matched the user's name 'pagos-dev' (get_instances with Name=pagos-dev returned empty); the agent assumed 'aws-cdarg-sentinel-ec2-dev' (i-02f1e51c559c9c557) was the intended instance and proceeded to query metrics without confirming this mapping with the user
get_metric call returned 'Tool call timed out' with error status
Second identical get_metric call also returned 'Tool call timed out' with error status
Third consecutive identical get_metric call (same instance_id, metric, minutes) after two timeouts, with no change in parameters, no backoff strategy, and no alternative approach
Third identical get_metric call again returned 'Tool call timed out' with error status

Agent ended the interaction without delivering the requested CPU average and without exploring alternatives (e.g., get_alarms for CPU alarm state, other available tools) or asking the user to confirm the target instance

root_causes.root_cause_explanation: At span f2cc7382ee2dccf3 the agent silently equated the user's requested instance 'pagos-dev' with 'aws-cdarg-sentinel-ec2-dev' (i-02f1e51c559c9c557) after the Name=pagos-dev lookup returned an empty result, because the system prompt forbids saying 'no sé' and gives no rule for disambiguating or confirming resource identity with the user. This corrupted the target-resource state so every subsequent get_metric call (and the final answer) referenced an unverified instance, making any result unreliable.
root_causes.fix_recommendation: Add an instruction requiring the agent to explicitly confirm resource identity with the user (or list candidate instances) when a name lookup returns no exact match, and remove/soften the 'never say you don't know' directive that pushes the agent to guess.

root_causes.root_cause_explanation: The get_metric call at span 57c94c4a8e7572b2 returned 'Tool call timed out' with error status, indicating the metrics backend/CloudWatch integration was unreachable or exceeded its execution window. Because this was the only data source used, the requested 30-minute CPU average could never be obtained and the agent entered a retry loop.
root_causes.fix_recommendation: Investigate and fix the get_metric tool's connectivity/latency to the CloudWatch API and add server-side timeout handling with retry plus a partial-data or cached-metric fallback.

root_causes.root_cause_explanation: The second get_metric invocation at span 59f2462c6828556c timed out again because the agent re-issued byte-identical parameters immediately after the first timeout, with no backoff or reduced time window, so the same underlying backend timeout condition recurred. This consumed another turn without producing any metric data.
root_causes.fix_recommendation: Implement exponential backoff and a smaller default query window inside the get_metric tool so repeated identical requests do not deterministically hit the same timeout.

root_causes.root_cause_explanation: At span 7cc8f2f4ce30210d the agent issued a third byte-identical get_metric call after two consecutive timeouts, with no parameter change, no backoff and no alternative tool (e.g., get_alarms), because the system prompt provides no error-handling or retry-strategy guidance. This produced a pure repetition loop that wasted turns and delivered no data.
root_causes.fix_recommendation: Add explicit error-recovery guidance limiting identical tool retries (e.g., max one retry) and requiring the agent to vary parameters (shorter window) or switch to alternative tools such as get_alarms after repeated timeouts.

root_causes.root_cause_explanation: The third get_metric execution at span 02a6b011d79e47ee timed out again, a direct downstream effect of the agent's unchanged repeated retry at span 7cc8f2f4ce30210d against a persistently failing metrics backend. With all metric retrieval paths exhausted, the task could not be completed.
root_causes.fix_recommendation: Harden the get_metric tool with a circuit-breaker that returns a descriptive, actionable error (and any partially available datapoints) instead of a bare timeout after repeated failures.

root_causes.root_cause_explanation: At span 7e51f4a40bcef0c2 the agent terminated the interaction reporting only the timeout, without trying alternative data sources (get_alarms for CPU alarm state) or asking the user to confirm the correct instance name, because the system prompt lacks fallback/escalation instructions for unavailable telemetry. The user received no CPU average and no verified instance mapping, leaving the request entirely unfulfilled.
root_causes.fix_recommendation: Add instructions requiring the agent, before ending a turn on tool failure, to attempt documented alternative tools and to ask the user a clarifying question (e.g., confirm the instance) rather than terminating with an error-only response.
